observations.family_crest: The Witchaven levers are ordered stages. Chronozon requires all four Blast hits. The route reserves spare casts and accounts for the four required casts. The November update gives 2,000 XP in each of Mining, Smithing and Crafting at the final hand-in.
observations.family_pest: The 500,000-coin payment unlocks all three gauntlet types. Claims share ownership flags with the original enchantments.
observations.horror_from_the_deep: The two bridge repairs consume 30 nails and one plank each. Fairy ring ALP approaches from Zanaris as soon as fairy rings are available. Jossik opens the casket after the fight to grant a book of Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix. All other books are separate purchases.
observations.devious_minds: The monk's orb must be packed into a large pouch and carried via the Abyss Law rift. The rift allows combat gear into the Law Altar interior from the November 11 update. The draft keeps the Entrana check at the portal onto the island and on the ferry.
observations.bear_your_soul: Find the Journey of Souls in the Arceuus Library, dig up the damaged item at the church, and visit the Key Master in Taverley Dungeon.
observations.in_search_of_knowledge: Five pieces of suitable food heal Aimeri. The three tomes use four pages each. Logosia grants a retained 10,000 XP lamp in the dialogue after the tome hand-in and pays for spare pages.
